item.title: Carmel’s holiday tree recycling day: Give your Christmas tree a second life
item.description: CARMEL, Ind. (WISH) — Reduce, reuse, recycle! (Even your Christmas trees). Carmel Clay Parks & Recreation (CCPR) will hold its annual Holiday Tree Recycling Day on Friday, Jan. 9 from 1 to 4 p.m. at Westermeier Commons in Central Park. During this drive-through recycling event, participants are able to bring their live, non-decorated holiday trees […]

item.title: Heartland Film’s fundraiser Cinemania to celebrate classic Westerns
item.description: Heartland Film's signature fundraiser, Cinemania, will return in April with a tribute to Westerns, featuring "The Magnificent Seven" and other movies, and led by philanthropists Lynda Goeke-Katz and Don Katz.

item.title: Colts Insider weighs in on decision to bring back Steichen, Ballard
item.description: The Colts have decided to bring back head coach Shane Steichen and General Manager Chris Ballard for the 2026 season, despite a seven-game losing streak to end the season and five straight years without a playoff appearance.

item.title: Feds ramp up immigration enforcement in Minneapolis
item.description: The Trump administration is deploying around 2,000 federal agents to Minneapolis as part of an immigration crackdown following a welfare fraud scandal in Minnesota, with the majority of those affected being Somali-Americans.

item.title: Free admission days, new exhibits highlight Indiana State Museum’s 2026
item.description: The Indiana State Museum has announced its 2026 public events schedule, featuring family-friendly activities, new exhibits, and several free admission days, including events themed around America's 250th birthday.

item.title: Tipton County hunter drives himself to Dollar General after crossbow injury
item.description: A 49-year-old man from Tipton County was accidentally shot in the leg with an arrow while hunting and drove himself to a Dollar General for help before being transported to a hospital for treatment.

item.title: Indianapolis man charged, accused of shooting wife in front of kids
item.description: Cecil Mains was charged with fatally shooting his wife, Jeri Mains, in front of their children after she had removed him from their home for cheating and had a restraining order against him.

item.title: Mild week ahead with potential for multiple systems late this week | Jan. 5, 2026
item.description: This week in Indiana will bring mild weather with a potential late in the week for multiple systems, including heavy rain, thunder, and severe storm potential, followed by colder air returning.

item.title: Residents of Twin Hills Apartments left without running water for weeks
item.description: Residents of Twin Hills Apartments have been without running water for over three weeks, causing unsanitary conditions and forcing some to stay with family, while management has yet to make any repairs.

item.title: Residents voice concerns over proposed data center at Shelbyville meeting
item.description: The Shelbyville, Indiana, Common Council on Jan. 5, 2026, voted 5-1 to annex 429 acres near I-74 and State Road 44, despite concerns from residents about the environmental and health safety impacts of a proposed data center on the site.
